ns2:course.label: Microeconomic Theory I
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes microeconomic theory particularly theory of the consumer, theory of the firm, general equilibrium analysis and welfare analysis. Also, covers uncertainty in general equilibrium and informational economics. Prerequisite: ECON 302 and ECON 303 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECON 302 and ECON 303 or equivalent.
